Welcome, We’re So Glad You’re Here
We are thrilled to announce the launch of the Keapure Affiliate Program—an exciting new chapter in our journey to bring transformative skincare to a wider audience. This program is designed to build strong partnerships with passionate individuals who share our mission of empowering people to embrace their best selves through honest and effective skincare solutions.
At Keapure, we believe in the power of collaboration and community. This affiliate program is not just about driving sales; it’s about creating a network of advocates who resonate with our values of transparency, innovation, and authenticity. Together, we aim to educate, inspire, and help people achieve radiant, healthy skin.
We look forward to building lasting relationships with our affiliates, providing them with the tools, support, and rewards to succeed while growing the Keapure brand. Let’s make this journey rewarding and fulfilling for everyone involved!

Brand Introduction
Keapure is an innovative skincare brand dedicated to combining the power of nature and cutting-edge technology to deliver transformative skincare solutions. With a focus on honest, transparent, and effective products, Keapure empowers individuals to embrace their best selves. Our product lines address a wide range of skin concerns, from anti-aging to acne control, ensuring all our customers can achieve radiant, healthy skin at any age.

Affiliate Programs Exclusive Perks:
Welcome Bonus: Receive a $50 bonus for generating your first 5 sales within 30 days.
Exclusive discounts to offer your customers only available through you
Commissions increase as sales grow plus bonuses
30 Day Cookie duration
Good average order size providing solid commissions on every sale
Access to new product launches before the general public. 
Generous and exclusive discount codes for personal use 
Personalized Affiliate Dashboard
Track sales and commissions in real time
Affiliate tracking with links and coupons

Manage payout details easily.
Customizable Coupons
Access to marketing tips tailored for skincare promotion.
Skincare ingredient guides and Keapure product knowledge.
Fast and easy to get started

 Affiliate Skincare Product Program
High Commission Rates: Earn up to 20% per sale, with potential for escalation.
Welcome Bonus: Receive a $50 bonus for generating your first 5 sales within 30 days.
Escalation Tiers: Increase commissions as sales grow:
Tier 1: 10% base commission (0-10 sales/month)
Tier 2: 15% (11-20 sales/month)
Tier 3: 20% (21+ sales/month)
Performance Bonuses: Monthly cash rewards for hitting milestones.
$100 bonus for 60+ sales/month
$250 bonus for 120+ sales/month

Affiliate Device Program
Focus on High-Ticket Items: Specifically tailored for promoting skincare devices like the MaskBella LED Facial Mask.
Commission Structure:
Tier 1: 20% base commission (0-5 sales/month).
Tier 2: 25% (5+ sales/month).
Special Rewards:
$150 bonus for affiliates selling 15+ devices in a month
$250 bonus for affiliates selling 30+ devices in a month 

Affiliate Support:
Exclusive training sessions on how to market the MaskBella LED Facial Mask.
Ready-to-use promotional materials, including videos and high-resolution images.
Access to Keapure’s affiliate manager for personalized guidance. 

Unique Selling Points (USPs)
- Nature Meets Science: A unique fusion of high-quality natural ingredients and advanced biotechnology.
- Transparency and Trust: No false promises or exaggerated claims just real results.
-Targeted Solutions: Tailored products for diverse skin concerns, including anti-aging, acne, dullness, and sensitivity.
- Innovative Technology: Devices like the MaskBella LED Facial Mask, which use proven technologies for professional-grade results at home.
- Dermatologically Tested: All products are safe, effective, and free from harsh chemicals and parabens.

For any questions about the KEAPURE Affiliate Program please contact us at:
Iamanaffiliate@keapure.com
